pr_title: Don't try to build symbol maps when only writing relocatable file

issue_context.title: Don't try to write symbol map when building a relocatable file only
issue_context.body:
When NativeImageOptions.ExitAfterRelocatableImageWrite is set, there is no linker returned and there should be no linker invocation. 
When building an executable, this works fine. However, this ImageKind will now also introduce a main function in the relocatable file. This can be avoided by setting ImageKind to SharedLibrary, but this currently causes a NullPointerException as SharedLibraryViaCCBootImage will use the linker to generate a symbol map.
comments: This issue is fixed long since.

review_comments: Have you considered passing `Collections.emptyMap()` in case when `inv == null`?
